countries.label: Malaysia
countries.note: Top-ranked in halal food, Islamic finance and pharma/cosmetics for the twelfth year. Halal imports grew 12.4% to $30.6B in 2024.

countries.label: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: Largest holder of Islamic finance assets alongside Iran; Islamic banks are roughly three-quarters of domestic banking. Largest OIC halal importer.

countries.label: Indonesia
countries.note: World's largest Muslim population and largest halal food market. #1 in modest fashion. Top destination for Islamic-economy investment (~$1.6B across 40 deals).

countries.label: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: Moved to #2 in the 2025/26 ranking; top three in every sector and #1 in media & recreation. ~$1.5B in deals across 50 transactions.

countries.label: Bahrain
countries.note: Long-standing Islamic finance hub and a leading sukuk issuer.

countries.label: Jordan
countries.note: Islamic banks hold about 18% of domestic banking assets.

countries.label: Kuwait
countries.note: Islamic banks hold about half of the domestic banking market.

countries.label: Pakistan
countries.note: Entered the GIEI top ten for the first time in 2024/25.

countries.label: Türkiye
countries.note: Among the five largest OIC halal importers and a major exporter into OIC markets; #2 in modest fashion (2024/25).

countries.label: Qatar
countries.note: Islamic banks hold about 29% of domestic banking assets.

countries.label: United Kingdom
countries.note: Ranked 14th, up one place. The leading Western hub for Islamic finance and sukuk listings.

countries.label: Singapore
countries.note: Inside the GIEI top 15; MUIS certification is widely recognised across Southeast Asia.

countries.label: Iran
countries.note: Fully Sharia-compliant banking system; roughly a quarter of global Islamic finance assets. Largest modest-fashion market by spend.

countries.label: India
countries.note: Third-largest Muslim population; a leading supplier of halal meat into OIC markets.

countries.label: Bangladesh
countries.note: Second-largest national halal food market by spend after Indonesia.

countries.label: Nigeria
countries.note: Eighth-largest domestic halal market. Africa is the fastest-growing halal region at ~9.6% a year.

countries.label: Egypt
countries.note: Third-largest national halal food market by spend.

countries.label: Sudan
countries.note: Banking system is entirely Islamic.

countries.label: Morocco
countries.note: Topped halal-food deal value in 2023/24 with a $610M sugar acquisition.

countries.label: Russia
countries.note: A top-five supplier of halal-related goods into OIC markets.

countries.label: Senegal
countries.note: Rose 18 places to 25th in the 2024/25 ranking.

countries.label: Brunei
countries.note: Islamic banking is ~30% of the domestic banking system.

countries.label: United States
countries.note: A top-five supplier of halal-related goods into OIC markets.

countries.label: Brazil
countries.note: The largest exporter of halal meat to OIC countries, despite a tiny Muslim population.

countries.label: Australia
countries.note: Major halal meat exporter to the Gulf and Southeast Asia.
